What benefit justifies another independently deployed service here?
answer_criteria: Explains added failure and deployment costs
competencies.failure_trap: Using microservices or retries as unconditional reliability upgrades

competencies.exercise: Reproduce a SQL device aggregate in a small DataFrame job and compare output with the PostgreSQL or Python reference; record the installed Spark/runtime versions before claiming execution.
interview_questions: When is a DataFrame transformation evaluated?
Why can collect overwhelm the driver?
answer_criteria: Reconciles results with a simple reference
competencies.failure_trap: Calling a local DataFrame demo production distributed experience

competencies.exercise: Create a stream aggregate for device counts and compare its settled result with an identical batch input; explain which output mode is supported by the query.
interview_questions: What does a streaming trigger control?
Why do stateful operations need retained state?
answer_criteria: Compares settled stream results with batch truth
competencies.failure_trap: Assuming streaming means one continuously executing per-record function

competencies.topic: Event time, watermarks and late data
competencies.exercise: Replay sorted, disordered and deliberately late telemetry for a fixed window; record emitted results and explain accepted and excluded cases under the chosen query and version.
interview_questions: Does a watermark guarantee that later records can never arrive?
What do you trade when increasing the watermark delay?
answer_criteria: Distinguishes event time from arrival time
Avoids claiming a watermark reorders all events or a symmetric drop guarantee
competencies.failure_trap: Treating watermark delay as universal maximum real-world lateness

competencies.exercise: Restart a streaming query from a retained checkpoint and evaluate a PostgreSQL foreachBatch sink with explicit transactional deduplication; record whether each logical effect is repeated or preserved.
interview_questions: Does checkpointing alone make any external sink exactly-once?
Which changes can invalidate a checkpoint recovery assumption?
answer_criteria: Identifies source and sink recovery boundaries
Preserves or explicitly resets checkpoint identity
competencies.failure_trap: Importing Kafka-to-Kafka transaction guarantees into an arbitrary database sink

competencies.exercise: Join device events with a batch device dimension, then design a time-bounded stream-stream pairing experiment; show how missing or late counterparts affect inner and outer results.
interview_questions: Why can a stream-stream join retain unbounded state?
What does a time constraint add beyond a watermark?
answer_criteria: Separates join semantics from deduplication semantics
competencies.failure_trap: Adding a watermark without checking whether the actual join supports state cleanup

competencies.exercise: Compare uniformly distributed and hot-device data, inspect partition sizes and shuffle work, and justify a change using observed execution behavior.
interview_questions: Why can more partitions still leave one hot key slow?
When might broadcasting a table be unsafe?
answer_criteria: Accounts for shuffle and memory cost
competencies.failure_trap: Increasing partition count as an automatic cure for skew

competencies.exercise: Draw a proposed AWS deployment using application compute, MSK and RDS; label every managed and application-owned responsibility. Keep status design-only unless independently deployed and tested.
interview_questions: Which responsibilities remain yours when Kafka is managed?
What does a local Compose demo fail to establish about cloud operation?
answer_criteria: Maps each component to a need
Accounts for application security and recovery duties
competencies.failure_trap: Presenting a cloud diagram as hands-on deployment experience

competencies.exercise: Design separate ingress, relay and consumer roles with minimum MSK/database/secret access; identify a policy change that should be denied and explain its blast radius.
interview_questions: Why avoid long-lived access keys in application images?
How do workload and human identities differ?
competencies.failure_trap: Using one administrator credential for all services

competencies.exercise: Create an allowed connection matrix from ingress to broker and worker to database, specifying network controls and TLS trust. Explain how to keep data services private while clients reach the API.
interview_questions: Why does a private subnet not by itself enforce every access rule?
How do at-rest encryption and transport encryption address different threats?
competencies.failure_trap: Equating encryption or private addressing with tenant isolation

competencies.exercise: Write an MSK/RDS operations design with version compatibility, connection limits, partition strategy, monitoring and maintenance windows; identify what still requires application-level testing.
interview_questions: Does MSK remove consumer offset and processing responsibility?
How can many replicas exhaust the database connection budget?
answer_criteria: Distinguishes broker operation from application semantics
Uses documented service limits rather than remembered constants
competencies.failure_trap: Assuming managed services remove capacity planning and failure handling

competencies.topic: Cloud rollout, recovery and disaster design
competencies.exercise: Design a rollback-compatible worker release and database restore drill, including region or zone failure assumptions, ownership and proposed RPO/RTO. Label all unexecuted drills as designed.
interview_questions: Which failures do multiple containers on one laptop not isolate?
Can a rollback binary safely read all newly written rows?
answer_criteria: Does not claim an unexecuted recovery objective was met
competencies.failure_trap: Promising multi-zone availability from single-host container restarts

competencies.exercise: Create a dated cost worksheet with symbolic broker-hours, compute-hours, retained bytes and transfer; verify current prices only when choosing real resources and include teardown verification.
interview_questions: Which resources can keep costing money after the app stops?
Does a budget alert guarantee spending is capped?
answer_criteria: Includes teardown and residual storage checks
competencies.failure_trap: Treating a budget notification as a hard spending limit

competencies.topic: Eligibility, role scope and recruiter screening
competencies.exercise: Write actual employment and break dates, current availability, Pune/hybrid constraints and a 90-second role fit summary; mark unresolved requisition-specific eligibility explicitly.
interview_questions: What experience is directly relevant to backend, integration and streaming?
What are your actual career-break dates and current status?
answer_criteria: Does not invent a returnship break
Separates general program and role-specific conditions
Names required and optional skills accurately
competencies.failure_trap: Skipping eligibility while spending weeks on architecture

competencies.exercise: Complete the blind diagnostic in INTERVIEW_ROUNDS.md before reading its answer key; preserve attempts. Later recode from an empty directory and test a fresh variant that has not been read in the reference.
interview_questions: How did you distinguish your knowledge from reference-code familiarity?
Which skill remains unassessed despite the project working?
answer_criteria: Distinguishes reference build from human performance
competencies.failure_trap: Calling copied or previously viewed tasks unseen

competencies.exercise: Run the 60-minute coding mock, retaining source, compiler/test output and a spoken explanation; follow with a novel change in input size, ordering or memory constraints.
interview_questions: Why is this algorithm correct under the stated constraints?
How would you change it if the stream no longer fits memory?
answer_criteria: Adapts without reciting a memorized template
competencies.failure_trap: Spending the full session narrating architecture without solving the coding task

competencies.topic: Java and Python language deep dive
competencies.exercise: Use the language mock to explain equality/hash, mutable state, generators and concurrency; independently write tiny programs to settle uncertain outputs.
interview_questions: What assumption about runtime version affects your concurrency answer?
Can you explain the observed behavior from the language contract?
competencies.failure_trap: Giving universal GIL or Java implementation claims without version context

competencies.exercise: Run the SQL mock on a fresh schema with duplicates, missing effects, NULL values and timestamp ties; justify queries and one workload-driven index.
interview_questions: How do ties and NULLs change this result?
Why would an index help this query and hurt another workload?
answer_criteria: Measures rather than assumes plan improvement
competencies.failure_trap: Relying on a plausible-looking query without checking rows

competencies.exercise: Draw commit and crash traces, handle out-of-order work within a partition, and justify one durable database effect per logical ID under a bounded replay assumption.
interview_questions: Can a committed offset skip unfinished lower offsets?
What does exactly-once mean for your external database effect?
competencies.failure_trap: Using manual commit as a complete exactly-once proof

competencies.exercise: Design telemetry integration with declared rate, payload and freshness target; calculate storage and catch-up bounds, then respond to a hot key, outage and identity-conflict change.
interview_questions: When does a finite queue fill?
How does your answer change if input remains above sustainable processing rate?
answer_criteria: Revises the design when assumptions change
competencies.failure_trap: Quoting invented production rates or hiding overload behind Kafka

competencies.exercise: Run an incident mock where API acceptance is normal but effects stop; request concrete logs, lag, DB waits and errors before choosing a containment action.
interview_questions: What evidence separates a broker issue from a database bottleneck?
How will you know recovery did not lose or repeat business effects?
competencies.failure_trap: Resetting offsets or restarting everything before preserving evidence

competencies.exercise: Explain the reference project, then scrap it and implement a minimal slice independently. Retain a diff and new test evidence; state which parts you wrote, which tools assisted and which guarantees remain untested.
interview_questions: Show the code and test behind your strongest reliability claim.
What would fail if your key assumption no longer held?
answer_criteria: Can navigate and modify own code
Does not let a successful reference build mark human mastery
competencies.failure_trap: Claiming authorship or operational experience that the evidence does not support

competencies.exercise: Fill three STAR records using WMS/offline sync, IAM and a real defect or tradeoff; leave impact numbers blank unless supported and link allowable evidence without exposing employer secrets.
interview_questions: Which decision did you personally make?
How did you determine the change worked?
competencies.failure_trap: Replacing real backend experience with a fabricated Java/Kafka production history

competencies.exercise: Run client mock changes: 'never lose data', 'must deploy tomorrow', and 'add every optional technology'; negotiate precise outcomes, risks, phased scope and validation without inventing authority.
interview_questions: How do you communicate an uncertain delivery date?
How do you handle a requirement that contradicts current capacity or reliability constraints?
answer_criteria: Explains technical risk in plain language
competencies.failure_trap: Promising absolute guarantees to avoid a difficult scope conversation

competencies.exercise: Prepare factual responses for actual dates, work location, notice period and role motivation; practice a private-boundary-respecting career-break explanation only if there was a break.
interview_questions: Why this backend and integration role given your previous work?
Which responsibilities and assessment stages should you clarify for this requisition?
answer_criteria: Connects motivation to actual work and learning
Asks concrete role and process questions
competencies.failure_trap: Adopting a fictitious career break or compensation figure to match a template
